title: Wildfire Watch
briefing: Fires spread fast in summer. Build a small satellite that photographs the ground from orbit and sends the pictures home for a month.

intro.text: A wildfire can grow fast, and from the ground it is hard to see all of it.
From orbit a satellite sees a whole region at once. Smoke, burned land and active fire show up in its pictures.
intro.note: Satellite image of a wildfire: NASA Earth Observatory.

intro.text: You design a small CubeSat whose camera photographs Earth and sends the pictures home.
intro.note: In Margin the pictures are counted as data. The game doesn't detect real fires.

intro.text: Sunlight, battery, memory and a few minutes over each ground station decide how much gets home within a budget and what a launcher can lift.
Design it. Predict what will limit it. Fly it. Find out why.

title: Sandbox
briefing: No limits, no goals. Build anything and see what happens.
